ACCEPTANCE_RULE: overlap_ratio(ON) >= overlap_ratio(OFF reference) - delta_frozen AND new_global_sync(ON-OFF) == 0; delta_frozen = 2x max |OFF/OFF pairwise delta| over the two calibration OFF arms (envelope, declared semantics); any dropped/overflow CUPTI event invalidates the arm
PRIMARY_METRIC: overlap_ratio delta (ON vs OFF) with OFF/OFF trace calibration

TRACE_PARAMS.COMM_KERNEL_CLASSIFIER: chrome event cat=='kernel' and 'nccl' in name.lower()
TRACE_PARAMS.COMPUTE_KERNEL_CLASSIFIER: chrome event cat=='kernel' and 'nccl' not in name.lower()
TRACE_PARAMS.OVERLAP_DELTA_TOLERANCE: 2x max pairwise OFF/OFF delta (envelope; frozen before ON trace runs)
TRACE_PARAMS.TRACE_STEPS: 16 active (schedule idx 9-24) after 8 wait + 1 warmup; end inclusive per relax _create_torch_profiler
TRACE_PARAMS.TRANSFER_CLASSIFIER: cat in (gpu_memcpy,memcpy,gpu_memset,memset) - excluded from busy unions
